name: Jose Froilan Gonzalez
features: heavy-set powerful build, broad ruddy face, thick dark hair, wide shoulders straining the overalls, fierce concentrated expression, sleeves rolled
bio: El Cabezon — the big head. Fangio's countryman and complete opposite: bulky, brawling, hurling the car at the road. Gave Ferrari its first World Championship victory at Silverstone in 1951, beating the Alfettas that had never been beaten. Two championship wins, and a reputation for being fastest when angry.
